title: "Mr. Whiff"

### About Mr. Whiff

Mr. Whiff is my project for sniffing the air around different places – starting with where I live now: the San Juan Islands of Pacific Northwest America. It’s a setup you can make for around $100 with a Waveshare BME688 sensor as a digital nose, a Raspberry Pico W as a digital brain, a 3.7V battery for re-chargeable power, and an SD card for additional memory. 

The challenge I faced, as goes for all low-budget science, was to turn the readings coming out from this setup into a consistent, meaningful environmental data to interpret and learn from. Given that none of my reporting is peer-reviewed, I aim to write document my methods and findings for Mr. Whiff to be as clear and reproducible as possible. 

You can find a comments section at the bottom – please post here with any questions or comments you have about Mr. Whiff :)
